name: 全速出击
description: 所有存活友方棋子获得迅捷。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var turnNumber = Number(battle.turn.turnNumber); var allies = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && arePlayersAllied(battle, piece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId); }); allies.forEach(function(ally, index) { addStatusEffectById(ally.instanceId, { id: 'max-full-speed-swift-' + source.instanceId + '-' + ally.instanceId + '-' + turnNumber + '-' + index, type: 'deployment-first-move-free', name: '迅捷', visible: true, stacking: 'independent', grantedTurnNumber: turnNumber, currentDuration: 1, currentUses: 1, remainingUses: 1 }); }); return { success: true, message: source.name + '发动全速出击，使' + allies.length + '个友方棋子获得迅捷' }; }
